# Added BPMN dependencies

The workflow designer uses `bpmn-js` 18.31.0; the Node parser uses `bpmn-moddle` 10.3.1. Their upstream notices are included unchanged here. The application retains the diagram toolkit's visible attribution. Transitive dependencies and their notices are installed by `npm ci` from the checked-in lockfile.

- https://github.com/bpmn-io/bpmn-js
- https://github.com/bpmn-io/bpmn-moddle
